trackingNumber.description:
The tracking number belonging to the parcel preprocessed with DWS
Only 1 tracking number per API request

processingLocation.description:
The Asendia's location where the physical package will be processed.
If null, the processing location from API account settings will be used (BR-1-3)
Examples: SIN(Singapore), HON(Hong Kong), AUS(Australia) and NEW(New Zealand).

totalPackageWeight.description: The parcel’s actual weight for the given weightUnit

dimUnit.description:
The package's dimensional unit.
IMPORTANT (BR-1-4): For APAC DWS machines, this can be null.
When null, dimensions are assumed to be in MM and will be automatically converted to CM by dividing by 10.

machineId.description:
Unique identifier for the DWS machine (BR-5-3)
Will be stored as Scale ID in the system
